PM Modi addresses SRCC centenary, criticizes opposition

Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the centenary celebrations of Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC) in Delhi. During his address, he made several remarks critical of the opposition. He used the phrase 'Naraz Fufa' (angry uncle) to describe an entity that opposes everything, which was interpreted as a jibe at the opposition. Modi also referred to the opposition as 'Dimagi Naxals' (intellectual Naxals) and stated that the country was seeing their 'true colors'. He also used the phrase 'jhooth ki goonj' (echo of lies) in his remarks.
